name: MF
purpose: Durable user-controlled registry of World Server projects that must not be abandoned between chats.

projects.title: Gothic Destruction MVP
projects.reason: Preserve and finish the user-approved cannon destruction system where voxel stones physically scatter as independent bodies.
projects.currentNextAction: Preserve the accepted fragmentation baseline, complete World Server production certification without regressing per-voxel scattering or graphics-first HUD, then request explicit owner closure.
doNotRegress: Never replace visible voxel fragmentation with one glued cluster rigid body.
Do not reduce physics semantics merely to recover FPS; optimize rendering/budgets first.
Keep persistent player HUD minimal and graphics-first.
Do not hand out a stored URL without fresh live verification.

projects.title: Unified Matter + Voxel Physics / Noita sequential scenes
projects.reason: Finish the shared runtime required to reproduce all analyzed Noita-style scenes sequentially and support the same material, structural, fire, fracture and collapse operations for both pixels and voxels.
projects.currentNextAction: Refresh PR #432 against current master without rebuilding the runtime from scratch, resolve any real conflicts, rerun exact-head gates, merge safely, then produce and verify the full sequential reference-scene demo including mobile performance and persistence/realtime behavior.
doNotRegress: Keep one shared material/physics rule set for pixel2d and voxel3d; do not fork separate engines.
Do not replace real material reactions with scripted fake animation.
Keep structural/explosion work bounded and fail closed when budgets are exceeded.
Normal Voxel World gameplay must remain opt-in for destructive physics until explicitly enabled.
Do not call the project finished merely because PR #432 or a standalone lab is green.
Do not invent readiness gains without new evidence.

projects.title: Living Watercolor 3D / Illustration Worker
projects.reason: Finish the Illustration-First watercolor worker while preserving already accepted object baselines and KayKit motion transfer.
projects.currentNextAction: Continue from the preserved source branch; improve only the worker visual shell against the user's sketch, keep 139/132 animation coverage and accepted object baselines, then request explicit visual acceptance.
doNotRegress: Do not reduce the accepted KayKit motion library (139 source clips / 132 unique motions).
Do not change accepted house, tree, power-plant, volcano or volcano-smoke baselines merely to fix the worker.
Do not treat structural/runtime PASS as user visual acceptance.
Do not hand out the stored URL without fresh live verification.
